tests.required: All 18 claim-bearing fields uniquely content-bound including variance and native codes. New variance creates new ref and preserves old ref.
Immutable deep snapshot: mutable caller-provided source primitives cannot corrupt historical ref after registration.
Ref source/version/year must be checked on retrieve and consumer; falsified version or source cannot pass with same full digest.
Extra fields on reference and caller self-issued arbitrary authority string must not upgrade evidence grade.
Caller-rehashed product delta/variance cannot override independently recomputed registered wave values.
Native category 0, DK REFUSED MISSING NOT_ASKED and denominators rechecked on read; 2012 Q43 2022 Q31 remain independent.
Rehashed changes to time_order, historical_requested/intervening, query_asof, issued_EE12, registry_authority must refuse or derive canonical values.
Publisher release/asof chronology comes from trusted facts, not caller product.
Previously completed read fails after wave source revocation; revocation enforced at actual consumer dereference.
Two different wave sources must have valid distinct immutable registry refs and permission scope; no source issuer manufactured from test-only authority.
Single-category shift changes delta and read digest, variance-only shift changes variance and registry ref but leaves delta stable.
Cold-process replay must rehydrate authenticated roots; in-memory strings alone are not original source custody.
Unchanged original T8C19 and original T8R3 must be distinguished from author's T8F2 21 and adapted T8I16; no renaming equivalent tests as originals.
No original Afrobarometer rows, source issuer, EE12, N8E, historical N9 or V3 permission.
